IBA Report 13-19, Review of the FY 2014 Proposed Budget

years.note: The IBA counted $23.7M of one-time money used to balance the proposed budget, and states no one-time spending to net against it. The review says the budget used 'approximately $19.6 million (44%) in ongoing resources and $23.7 million (56%) in one-time resources' (IBA Report 13-19, page 1). The largest item was $21.6M of one-time SDG&E settlement money from the Public Liability Reserve (page 1); the rest is not itemized.

Not reported: the IBA's review of the FY 2015 proposed budget (IBA Report 14-15) states no total. It says 'With negligible use of one-time resources and sound revenue assumptions, this proposed budget and its corresponding service levels are likely more sustainable than those proposed over the past eight years' (page 1). Page 7 lists only some items, such as $5.4 million of one-time use of Transient Occupancy Tax fund balance, and no total is printed, so no figure is shown.

Not reported: the IBA's review of the FY 2016 proposed budget (IBA Report 15-16) states no amount of one-time money used for ongoing costs and no structural deficit or balance statement, so no figure is shown.

years.note: The IBA listed $52.1M of one-time money in the proposed budget; this is a sum of listed items, not net of one-time spending. years.note: The IBA listed $44.6M of one-time money in the proposed budget; this is a sum of listed items, not net of one-time spending. The items (IBA Report 19-06, pages 3-4) are $30.7M of excess equity, $4.8M of Long Term Disability reserve, $4.0M from the Infrastructure Fund, $2.6M of Public Liability reserve and $2.5M from the Capital Outlay Fund for debt service. The review says '62% are one-time' of the $72.4M of balancing actions.

Not reported: the IBA's review of the FY 2021 proposed budget (IBA Report 20-06) says the budget uses 'one-time resources to support ongoing expenditures', including '$7.9 million in Pension Payment Stabilization Reserve funds and $16.9 million in anticipated stadium sale proceeds' (page 8). That is a partial list with no total, so no figure is shown.
